description: This Swift source file defines a utility enum 'WebViewJavaScriptSupport' providing static functions to interact with a WKWebView instance, executing JavaScript code to set debug status, evaluate JavaScript to string asynchronously, and generate JavaScript-safe string values.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into WKWebView to update the debug status and optional status messages based on the provided parameters.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates JavaScript in WKWebView and returns the result as a String, throwing an error if evaluation fails.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Converts an optional String into a JavaScript-safe String literal, or 'null' if the input is nil or invalid.
